# OpenSocrates 1.5.0 — Mac reasoning assistance

This version builds from the released v1.4 foundation. It preserves the original
48 reasoning methods and complete English/Korean procedures, and adds focused
guidance for understandable source synthesis, decisions, stakeholder context,
and useful messages. Mechanical work still needs no reasoning ceremony. The
withdrawn earlier v1.5 candidate is not this release's implementation baseline.
Dedicated coding specialists, a new project-memory store, and broad orchestration
are outside this version's added scope.

## Distribution profiles

- **Codex:** the existing native package and installer lifecycle remain available.
- **Claude Code on Apple-silicon Mac:** a native companion supplies bounded
  SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit entry and the deterministic decision runtime.
  Stop/SessionEnd are nonblocking no-ops. Entry does not make an additional
  selector-model call or read private transcripts.
- **Claude Chat/Desktop/Cowork account content:** a standalone skill ZIP contains
  one controller and all 96 complete EN/KO procedure files. Export and account
  upload are separate operations. Account upload, authentication, permissions,
  enabled state, and ordinary-request matching must be checked on the actual
  account; the ZIP does not prove activation or every-message use.
- **Antigravity on Mac:** a content-only always-on rule plus skill supports an
  explicit workspace or separately qualified global scope. Installation preserves
  unrelated rules and never appends to user `GEMINI.md` or `AGENTS.md`.

New Claude and Antigravity Windows qualification follows separately. Existing
Codex Windows artifacts and checks remain a distinct support lane; they do not
qualify the new hosts. Intel Mac, Windows ARM64, remote/cloud native executables,
and universal model-quality or efficiency gains are not newly claimed.

## Assets and lifecycle

The Mac-stage artifacts are `opensocrates-1.5.0-claude-plugin.zip`,
`opensocrates-1.5.0-claude-chat-skills.zip`, and
`opensocrates-1.5.0-antigravity-plugin.zip`, each with a SHA-256 sidecar. The
release also carries the retained Codex artifacts and source/package inventories.
When using the standalone `opensocrates.mjs` asset, place the verified
`managed-hosts.mjs` dependency beside it. The npm installer includes that module.

Managed addon install/update/disable/enable/remove checks exact ownership and
complete content hashes, refuses modified/unowned/linked targets, and preserves
rollback state. These operations do not reset global trust or purge account homes.
Claude account activation remains in the supported account UI; a local export is
not an installed account skill.

## Evidence boundaries

Source fixtures, local lifecycle checks, generated package checks, and native
entry emission are separate from live host delivery and reader usefulness.
Consult the exact release manifest, checksums, limitations, and current Mac guide
for the verified commit/package identities and any pending authenticated or live
host cells. Missing account authentication or an inaccessible host stays pending;
another platform's passing test is not a replacement. A grounding line or an
emitted entry does not prove that a method was read, applied, or improved a result.

These notes are prepared release content. Their presence in the repository does
not publish the release, replace an active installation, or complete a pending
account/host acceptance lane.
